name: Our Story (About page)
tone: warm, personal, proud but modest, written like the owner talking to a customer, not corporate
facts: Mantassa Crafts (মানতাসা ক্রাফটস) is a women-owned handmade jewelry studio based in Bidhannagar, Kolkata, West Bengal
founded and run by Sreshta Ghosh
started as a small home studio hand-painting fabric and terracotta jhumkas
signature product is earrings personalized with the customer's name hand-painted in Bengali or English script
known for pom-pom trims, silver-toned jhumka bells, and folk art style hand painting
has a 4.8 out of 5 rating on Google from customers who praised product quality, friendliness, and on-time delivery
grew through word of mouth and repeat customers
is now being revived and expanded online, adding fine jewelry, watches and accessories, and home and gifting items alongside the original personalized earrings
every piece is still handmade to order, not mass produced
orders are confirmed with the customer over WhatsApp before being made, there is no online payment on the website
